name: Content Refresh Assistant
author: remigo1115

sections.description:
Content Refresh Assistant is built for the post-AI SEO era: maintaining and improving existing content beats constantly publishing new posts.

In 10 minutes you get:

  • A refresh diagnosis (score + priority)
  • A step-by-step refresh plan (actionable tasks)
  • Internal link suggestions as bonus value inside the refresh workflow

No tracking. No ads. Lightweight by design.

Key Features

  • Refresh Score (0-100) + Priority (P0/P1/P2)
  • Actionable Refresh Plan tasks (e.g., update_intro, fix_structure_headings)
  • Internal link suggestions (top related posts)
  • Fast metrics: word count, reading time, days since update, link counts
  • Works inside WP Admin (Tools → Content Refresh)
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install it from the WordPress plugin screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen.
  3. Go to Tools → Content Refresh, select a post, and click “Generate Refresh Plan”.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin send data to external servers?

No. By default, all analysis is performed on your WordPress site. (Optional AI-assisted features may be added later as opt-in.)

Who can use this plugin?

Users need the edit_posts capability.

Will this slow down my site?

The plugin is designed to be lightweight. It analyzes a single selected post on demand.

Where do I find it after activation?

WP Admin → Tools → Content Refresh.

Does it modify my content automatically?

No. It generates a plan and suggestions. Applying changes is manual.
